text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're about halfway through summer
camp, and we've just finished
another solid
day of training.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, would you happen to have some
time after this?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There's somewhere I was hoping we could
go together. If you don't
mind, how about
it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's unusual for her to invite me to
something. I wonder where she's
taking
me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we're waiting at the bus stop in
front of
camp, crowds of students
dressed in
yukata pass by.

text_block_list.name: Students in Yukata
text_block_list.text:
What do you wanna do first? Maybe
takoyaki and... oh, the shooting gallery! 
After we look around a little, we should
hurry and save a spot! I can't
wait for the fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hear that?
I guess there's a festival going
on nearby. And they're
doing fireworks
too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (The sputtering of a bus draws near.)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That's us, that bus right there.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Phew, here we are. Reception is... ah,
thataway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following her gaze, I spot people writing
messages and drawing pictures on sheets
of traditional paper, then making them
stand
upright with bamboo sticks.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I'm glad you think so...
It seemed like
something you would like,
so I thought it
might be fun to come out here together.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Now then, I wonder what I should wish for.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, maybe this sort of thing is best kept
secret. They say your wish is
more likely to
come true that way, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm thinking of my wish, all the days
we've spent together replay in
my mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute showed up in my life just as
I was thinking I should
give up on being a
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Time and time again, she inspired me and
reignited my passion. Her drive and
tenacity stirred up emotions in me that
had
lain buried.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then,
she chose me to be her trainer. I
couldn't have been
happier. As long as I'm
with her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With each brushstroke, I capture my pure
and honest feelings in this
moment.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
See that? There was a firefly just now.
That means the stream must be
gentle around
here. Trainer,
this looks like a good spot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The water is already dotted with lanterns,
their reflections dancing
quietly in the
night.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Okay, time to release them. And off we
go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our lanterns seem to be in no rush as they
leisurely drift away from
the bank.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We watch in silence until they finally
join
up with the rest, their soft
and gentle
lights now one with many.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With our wishes sent off, Acute and I
slowly make our way back to the
bus stop.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Not a soul around. What a peaceful night.
And...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chitter, chitter...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Mm... You hear that?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh... And you know what that means.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Mhm, it sure is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a lull in the conversation, and I
suddenly notice my throat is
parched.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Here, Trainer. Wet your whistle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thirst quenched, I lose myself once more in the chirping of the insects. Everything about this moment feels so comfortable and natural, almost as if...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Funny, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now, I hope you won't laugh at me for
saying this, but being here
with you,
somehow I...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling that you and I have been
together for a long, long
time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Were you now?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Now how is it that we were both
thinking the exact same
thing? That seems
a little strange.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you're right. And you know...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Well,
I think I'm sure of it now. The bond
that ties us together will...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Maybe I didn't need to write that
after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's get going. Slowly,
now... side by
side, we'll take this road
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later that evening...

text_block_list.name: Girlfriend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's water lanterns!
They're so pretty...
Haha, look! See those two
over there?

text_block_list.name: Boyfriend
text_block_list.text:
"May the two of us run strong together
forever after."
"May the bond between my
trainer and I remain strong forever
after."

text_block_list.name: Girlfriend
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Their wishes are the exact same. I
guess that means they've
already come
true.
